LEAGUEANCIENTS-DISABLE_BASE_GAME_ANCIENT:
If set, the normal game Ancients can not be encountered in a run.

[color=#C0C0C0]If [blue]Disable League Ancients[/blue] is set as well, the normal Ancients will not be disabled![/color]
LEAGUEANCIENTS-DISABLE_LEAGUE_ANCIENTS.h: If set, the League Ancients can not be encountered in a run.
